title: #BCTalent in North America: Bridging the Talent Gap Together

features.name: BC Talent Program
features.description: A full-force skilling and coaching machine that trains consultants with industry experience through product training, professional skills, and one-to-one coaching sessions.

features.name: Partner Engagement and Skilling
features.description: Program enabling 233 partner engagements globally with 74 in North America, reducing time from onboarding to billable work to 10 weeks.

features.name: Talent Retention and Diversity
features.description: BC Talent program achieving 93 percent retention rate and 41 percent of new hires are women, building a more diverse ecosystem.

quotes.text: In the current war for talent, finding people is the hardest part.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core challenge the video addresses - talent acquisition in competitive market.

quotes.text: Getting them in front of your customers and actually driving your business forward, that's the real game.
quotes.why_it_matters: Reframes the real challenge beyond hiring to ensuring new talent delivers business value quickly.

quotes.text: VC talent is a full force skilling and coaching machine and the results they speak loud and clear.
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces the BC Talent program and emphasizes it is operational with measurable results.

quotes.text: 10 weeks from onboarding to billable work so you keep moving forward no slowdown.
quotes.why_it_matters: Quantifies the speed-to-value metric, demonstrating rapid time from hire to productive work.

quotes.text: 93% retention rate because when talent is trained and coached right they stay.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the program's effectiveness in retaining skilled employees through proper training and coaching.

quotes.text: We're not just filling jobs. We're building a more diverse, innovative future for Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Articulates the program's broader mission beyond hiring to creating diversity and innovation.
